Rashi on Meilah 8a:1:1.hebrew: אבל לענין להתירו לאכילה - לא אמר שתהא זריקה מועלת. והיינו דקאמר "איסורא איכא", דאסורה באכילה משום יוצא:
Rashi on Meilah 8a:1:1.english: But with regard to permitting it for eating - [Rabbi Akiva] did not say that the sprinkling is effective. And this is what he means when he says, "There is a prohibition," for it is forbidden to eat because of [the law of] "yotze" [that which has gone out].

Rashi on Meilah 8a:3:1.hebrew: חטאת העוף מועלין בה משהוקדשה - בפה, אפילו אם נהנה ממנה מחיים, כגון שמכרה, דהוציאה לחולין:
Rashi on Meilah 8a:3:1.english: A bird sin offering — one is liable for misuse of it from the moment it was consecrated - By mouth [i.e., by verbal designation], even if one derived benefit from it while alive, such as [if] one sold it, for [thereby] he removed it to non-sacred status.

Rashi on Meilah 8a:3:2.hebrew: הוכשרה להפסל - כלומר, משנמלקה ניתוסף בה קדושה, שהיא נפסלת אם נגע בה טבול יום או מחוסר כפורים, ובלינה:
Rashi on Meilah 8a:3:2.english: It was rendered susceptible to disqualification - That is to say, once its neck was pinched, [an additional] sanctity was added to it, such that it is disqualified if a *tevul yom* or one who lacks atonement touches it, and through being left overnight.

Tosafot on Meilah 8a:3:1.hebrew: חטאת העוף - עד השתא איירי בדין פסולי קדשים, מתי ימעלו בהם; ומכאן ואילך איירי בכשרים:
Tosafot on Meilah 8a:3:1.english: A bird sin offering - Until now [the Mishnah] dealt with the law of disqualified consecrated items, [and] when one is liable for misuse of them; and from here on it deals with valid ones.

Tosafot on Meilah 8a:3:2.hebrew: מועלין בהן משהוקדשו - פירוש: קדושת פה, דהיינו כשהקדישן:
Tosafot on Meilah 8a:3:2.english: One is liable for misuse of them from the time they were consecrated - Meaning: [from the time of] consecration by speech, that is, when one consecrated them:

Tosafot on Meilah 8a:3:3.english: "It was rendered susceptible to disqualification through [contact with] one who immersed that day, and through [contact with] one who has not yet brought an atonement offering" - That is to say, if [one who immersed that day or one who has not yet brought an atonement offering] touched it, it is disqualified from being eaten:
